title: Best Keywords to Use for Med Spa Google Ads Campaigns

facts.fact: The page states that in high-competition medical aesthetics industries, cost per click (CPC) may be USD 5 to USD 20 or more, so every click counts.
facts.quote: In high-competition industries such as medical aesthetics where CPC may be USD 5-USD 20 or more every click counts.

facts.fact: The page recommends using Exact Match or Phrase Match for high-intent med spa keywords such as "Botox near me" to limit spending on broader, low-intent searches.
facts.quote: By using exact match for this term, you can avoid spending money on broader, low-intent searches like **"Botox vs filler" or "Botox dangers."**

facts.fact: The page recommends adding negative keywords such as "free," "DIY," and "how to" to filter out low-quality traffic from users in the research phase.
facts.quote: Filter out terms like free, "DIY," or "how to" to avoid paying for non-converting clicks from users in the research phase.

facts.fact: The page states that "best med spa in [City]" searches have high commercial intent, and recommends Exact or Phrase Match for them.
facts.quote: **Match Type: Exact Match or Phrase Match - \[best med spa in Austin\] or "best med spa in Austin."**
